Case :- Application U/S 529 Bnss No. - 1722 of 2025
Applicant :- Smt. Kalpana @ Gudiya
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 5 Others

Counsel for Applicant :- Subedar Mishra
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Nalin Kumar Srivastava,J.
1.

This application under Section 529 Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita (hereinafter referred to as
B.N.S.S.) has been filed with a prayer to direct the learned trial court to decide Old Case No. 70 of
2020, New Case No. 38 of 2020 (State Vs. Deep Aryan and others) arising out of Case Crime No. 41
of 2018, under Sections 498A, 323, 354 (kha), 406 I.P.C. and 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police
Station Mahila Thana, District Bulandshahar, pending before the Civil Judge (Junior Division)/
Judicial Magistrate, Ftc, Court No. 2, Bulandshahar, expeditiously within a stipulated period.

entities.text:
Civil Judge (Junior Division)/
Judicial Magistrate, Ftc, Court No. 2, Bulandshahar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State.
3. It is submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant is aggrieved wife.
It is further submitted that the matter is very old but the accused persons are not appearing before the court and causing delay in disposal of the case.

It is next submitted that another application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. No. 7703 of 2022 was filed before this Court wherein the learned trial court was Smt. Kalpana @ Gudiya vs State Of U.P. And 5 Others on 29 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/197751039/
1 directed to conclude the trial within a period of one year.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
It is also submitted that the opposite party no. 3 is Jeth, opposite party no. 4 is Jethani, opposite party no. 5 Nanad and opposite party no. 6 is Nandoi of the informant/applicant and an order was passed that until further orders of this Court,
no coercive action shall be taken against the applicants (opposite party nos. 3 to 6) but however, no stay order was passed in favour of the opposite party no. 2.

It is next submitted that although an order was passed by the learned trial court on 02.09.2022 to proceed with the case against the husband-opposite party no. 2 but however, no effective steps are being taken against him and the matter is still pending for appearance of the opposite party no. 2.
4. Learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer.
5. I have considered the submissions and perused the record.
6.

In the facts and circumstances of the case, the learned trial court is directed to proceed with the case in respect of opposite party no. 2-Deep Arayan (husband) and conclude the trial in respect of him in the aforesaid case as expeditiously as possible without granting any unnecessary adjournment to either of the parties, if there is no legal impediment.

7. It is also made clear that the Court/Presiding Officer is not the only stake holder in the trial and disposal of a case, hence, besides the P.O. concerned, all the stake holders i.e. police and execution authorities, advocates, parties to the case, staff are also made bound by this order and it will be their responsibility also to assist the Court in every manner for the expeditious disposal of this case.
8.
With the above observations, the application stands disposed of.

Order Date :- 29.5.2025 Rmk.
